newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO's lease unit 1996 net up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO's lease unit 1996 net up 12 pct.

text.p: ABN AMRO Lease Holding NV said on Friday its 1996 net profit had risen by 12 percent to 132 million guilders from 117.3 million in the previous year.
The lease contracts portfolio grew by 1.2 billion guilders to 9.2 billion and total assets increased by 1.7 billion to 10.4 billion guilders.

"Despite the signs of markets maturing, especially in a number of Western European countries, ABN AMRO Lease Group was again able to maintain its profitability at a very good level in 1996," the unit of ABN AMRO Bank said. It added it saw sustained growth in 1997 in volumes and regional coverage.
